scope_notes: Same 128-proposal 4KiB lifecycle followed by 8KiB text/spend and 4KiB parameter changes for baseline, root-only and root+inline-metadata.
The former 32/96 lifecycle batches are now individually measured create/vote calls; counter assertions and SkipHeights are outside measured windows.
Root, nested metadata, and list reads are resource-only query scopes with zero transaction fee; retained assertions use exactly the same fixture on all three refs.
Root-only versus baseline isolates value-root storage and required writeback. Combined versus root-only isolates inline metadata plus direct metadata accessors.
No new contract code; immutable existing candidates use fresh-state setup, not migration. History remains after proposal execution/cancellation.
